title: MOE Short Term Research Award (STRA)
official_source: Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
duration: Between 2 and 6 months of research in Taiwan
description: The Ministry of Education Short Term Research Awards (STRA) are offered to international scholars, excluding scholars from mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao, to encourage them to undertake short term research in Taiwan of 2 to 6 months. Each award provides a monthly research allowance of NTD 25,000 for a Ph.D. student or NTD 40,000 for a postdoctoral fellow, together with economy class round-trip airfare for the most direct route between the awardee's place of residence and Taiwan. title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
official_source: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) Office of International Affairs
duration: Awards are generally valid for 1 year; maximum award duration is 4 years for undergraduates, 2 years for master's and 5 years for PhD students
description: NYCU's International Student Scholarship supports degree-seeking international students with a monthly stipend and/or a tuition award, applied for and awarded separately or together. Current students apply in semester windows of 15 January to 15 March and 15 July to 15 September; incoming students apply with their admission application. The page also lists the nomination-based Elite Ph.D. Scholarship (NT$33,000 per month plus a tuition waiver for two years) and a dedicated Ukrainian student scheme.
